svg.title: B09 EUROPA CHEMGRID — Yellowstone Geochemical Atlas engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram defines a versioned sample-to-map lineage and basin/time support boundary. Measured concentration, inferred facies and optional equilibrium interpretation remain separate products with explicit sparse-data limits.
